title: Microsoft Dynamics and the Microsoft ecosystem inside the company

videos.script: Serra Alta runs SAP. So why is this lesson about Microsoft? {{estate}} Because Microsoft is already everywhere in the company, whether anybody planned it or not. Every employee signs in through it. Most of the company's documents end up in it. {{tenant}} And in 2021 Serra Alta bought a cheese maker that runs its whole business on Microsoft Dynamics. {{family}} First, what the name Dynamics covers. It is several products with separate histories, under one brand. {{identity}} Then the tenant. Identity is the one integration every system already has. And somebody leaving the company is an integration with a deadline. {{shadow}} Then Power Platform. Joana counts two hundred and thirty flows built by staff, and thirty-eight of them reach into SAP. Her first idea is to block them. It is the wrong idea, and you will see why. {{erps}} Last, the question the acquisition left behind. Two ERPs in one group. Merge them, connect them, or only add up their books? Joana's answer depends less on either system than on a date.
